# Zaid Khan

> Static engineering portfolio of Zaid Khan, a B.Tech 2027 student at the National Institute of Technology Srinagar. He writes about and builds C++, systems programming, emulation, networking, and algorithms, and is open to software engineering internships and entry-level SDE / systems roles.

The site is static HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript, hosted on GitHub Pages. Project pages are problem-first case studies. Writing, RSS, and the sitemap are generated from `data/blog-posts.json`.

## Pages

- [Home](https://diaznakh.github.io/): Overview, selected work, writing, and contact
- [Work](https://diaznakh.github.io/work/): Featured case studies and a dated archive of smaller public repositories
- [Writing](https://diaznakh.github.io/writing/): Technical field notes
- [About](https://diaznakh.github.io/about/): Timeline, current focus, and education
- [Résumé (PDF)](https://diaznakh.github.io/assets/zaid-khan-resume.pdf)
